procedure.name: Q4
procedure.statement: SELECT o_ol_cnt, count(*) AS order_count FROM oorder JOIN order_line ON o_id = ol_o_id AND o_w_id = ol_w_id AND o_d_id = ol_d_id AND ol_delivery_d >= o_entry_d GROUP BY o_ol_cnt ORDER BY o_ol_cnt;

procedure.name: Q15
procedure.statement: UPDATE supplier SET su_suppkey = su_suppkey WHERE 1 = 0

SELECT su_suppkey, su_name, su_address, su_phone, total_revenue FROM supplier, (SELECT mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) AS supplier_no, sum(ol_amount) AS total_revenue FROM order_line, stock WHERE ol_i_id = s_i_id AND ol_supply_w_id = s_w_id AND ol_delivery_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY supplier_no) revenue0 WHERE su_suppkey = supplier_no AND total_revenue = (SELECT max(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) AS supplier_no, sum(ol_amount) AS total_revenue FROM order_line, stock WHERE ol_i_id = s_i_id AND ol_supply_w_id = s_w_id AND ol_delivery_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY supplier_no) revenue0_inner) ORDER BY su_suppkey;
UPDATE supplier SET su_suppkey = su_suppkey WHERE 1 = 0

procedure.name: Q21
procedure.statement: SELECT su_name, count(*) AS numwait FROM supplier, order_line l1, oorder, stock, nation WHERE l1.ol_o_id = o_id AND l1.ol_w_id = o_w_id AND l1.ol_d_id = o_d_id AND l1.ol_w_id = s_w_id AND l1.ol_i_id = s_i_id AND mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND l1.ol_delivery_d > o_entry_d AND l1.ol_number NOT IN (SELECT l2.ol_number FROM order_line l2 JOIN order_line l3 ON l2.ol_o_id = l3.ol_o_id AND l2.ol_w_id = l3.ol_w_id AND l2.ol_d_id = l3.ol_d_id AND l3.ol_delivery_d > l2.ol_delivery_d) AND su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'Germany' GROUP BY su_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, su_name;

procedure.name: Q22
procedure.statement: SELECT substring(c_state from 1 for 1) AS country, count(*) AS numcust, sum(c_balance) AS totacctbal FROM customer LEFT JOIN oorder ON o_c_id = c_id AND o_w_id = c_w_id AND o_d_id = c_d_id WHERE substring(c_phone from 1 for 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7') AND c_balance > ( SELECT avg(c_balance) FROM customer WHERE c_balance > 0.00 AND substring(c_phone from 1 for 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7')) AND o_id IS NULL GROUP BY substring(c_state from 1 for 1) ORDER BY substring(c_state from 1 for 1);
